title: Bright Quality

Sukkadhammasutta Bright Quality

Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati. At Sāvatthī.

“Dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko. “Possessions, honor, and popularity are grim …

Lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtassa pariyādiṇṇacittassa, bhikkhave, devadattassa sukko dhammo samucchedamagamā. Devadatta cut off his bright quality because his mind was overcome and overwhelmed by possessions, honor, and popularity.

Evaṁ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko …pe… So grim are possessions, honor, and popularity. …” sikkhitabban”ti.

Catutthaṁ.
